camera.derivation: chair-focused, all inputs measured from the live scene-graph dump (#342 walker): eyeX = chair cluster centre X (-0.400, union of 6 meshes matching /chair/i); eyeY = chair cluster centre Y + cluster height (0.465 + 0.930, min 1.0 m standing eye); eyeZ = interior max Z - 2 x wall thickness (2.804 - 2 x 0.121 = 2.561); look = chair cluster centre; wall thickness = exterior hull max Z - interior max Z, the #342 stand-off rule
